inclusion_rule: The same Mandarin lip-reading decoder population, classified from the full text (reference list removed) by whether an unseen-speaker (speaker-independent) evaluation is named and whether run-to-run variability (standard deviation, confidence interval, repeated runs, significance test) is reported. Boundary: mention counts (pattern match, upper bound); versions once. Population: Mandarin lip-reading decoders: text-output lip-reading, VSR or AVSR systems that take lip or face video at test and report a result on a Mandarin corpus (LRW-1000, CMLR, CAS-VSR, CN-CVS, CNVSRC, MAVD, own corpora). Excluded: perception, neuroimaging and education studies, surveys, dataset or challenge description papers that report no decoder (dataset papers with baseline decoders such as LRW-1000 are included), enhancement, separation, synthesis and talking-face generation, cued speech, keyword spotting, non-visual modalities, non-Mandarin decoders. Versions merged by title (titles filled from manifests). Dated by first public version against 2019-08 (window 2019-02 to 2020-02 = concurrent).
